required_tests.evidence: Real JavaFX/browser throwing callbacks escape once and do not become script errors; Android detached actual callback plus eight exact unchanged native-fault host methods verify synchronous/asynchronous callback/native exceptions, duplicate suppression and post-release delivery. iOS detached main callback escapes once; attached asynchronous app callbacks must not throw across Objective-C. retained_limitations: Native platform may drop an already-pending callback on destruction; no delivery/Promise-await guarantee beyond the documented start/completion contract.
